Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for Korean historical hand-painted 2.5D strategy game. Reference image is the existing 2D object atlas; redraw each object as a genuinely new isometric illustration, not a warped flat front. Preserve exact row-major identity and order, traditional Korean architecture, warm brown ink contours, detailed anime painting and material texture. Orthographic 2:1 isometric camera (30 degree elevation), visible roof/top plus two convincing side faces, parallel edges on two diagonal map axes. No perspective convergence, no front elevation views, no photorealism, no low-poly or 3D-render look. Transparent background with real alpha. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, sixteen equally sized invisible cells, centered complete separate object in each cell, wide transparent gutters, no overlap, no clipping, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no scenery background or large ground patch. Small contact shadow only. High resolution square atlas, all object edges crisp. Keep each object contained in its own cell with at least 12% padding.
Redraw all sixteen in EXACT original order: row1 tiled house, thatched cottage, raised wooden storehouse, long tiled warehouse; row2 vegetable market stall, walled courtyard home, earthen kiln workshop, small shrine; row3 broadleaf tree, golden birch pair, red maple, old pine; row4 tall granite crag, mossy rock/log cluster, willow and reeds, fenced vegetable garden. Buildings' entrance facade faces LOWER LEFT, their right side recedes UPPER RIGHT, visible roof ridges aligned the isometric X axis. Fenced farm must have a diamond-shaped ground footprint with rows receding, never a frontal rectangle. Trees seen from this same elevated camera, with full three-dimensional canopy depth.
